import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')

# Read workbook to get sheet name
wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
sheet = wb.find('.//m:sheet', ns)
print('Sheet name:', sheet.get('name'))

# Parse sheet1
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

def col_letter(ref):
    return re.match(r'[A-Z]+', ref).group()

rows = []
for row in root.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
    rnum = int(row.get('r'))
    cells = {}
    for c in row.findall('m:c', ns):
        ref = c.get('r')
        col = col_letter(ref)
        v = c.find('m:v', ns)
        val = v.text if v is not None else ''
        # check inline string
        is_ = c.find('m:is', ns)
        if is_ is not None:
            t = is_.find('m:t', ns)
            val = t.text if t is not None else ''
        cells[col] = val
    rows.append((rnum, cells))

maxcol = 0
for _, cells in rows:
    for col in cells:
        idx = 0
        for ch in col:
            idx = idx * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
        maxcol = max(maxcol, idx)

def to_excel_col(n):
    s = ''
    while n:
        n, r = divmod(n - 1, 26)
        s = chr(65 + r) + s
    return s

for rnum, cells in sorted(rows):
    line = []
    for i in range(1, maxcol + 1):
        line.append(cells.get(to_excel_col(i), ''))
    print(rnum, line)
EOF

import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

# Collect all rows: (row_number, {col: value})
data = {}
for row in root.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    cells = {}
    for c in row.findall('m:c', ns):
        col = ''.join(ch for ch in c.get('r') if ch.isalpha())
        v = c.find('m:v', ns)
        t = c.find('m:is/m:t', ns)
        cells[col] = t.text if t is not None else (v.text if v is not None else None)
    data[r] = cells

# Expense items are rows 11-22, amounts in column C
amounts = [float(data[r]['C']) for r in range(11, 23) if 'C' in data.get(r, {})]
cat_map = {}
for r in range(11, 23):
    cat = data[r].get('A')
    cat_map.setdefault(cat, []).append(float(data[r]['C']))

print('Expense line items:', amounts)
print('Count:', len(amounts), '| Sum:', sum(amounts))
print()
for cat, vals in cat_map.items():
    print(f'  {cat}: {sum(vals):,.2f}  ({", ".join(f"{v:g}" for v in vals)})')
print()
print(f'TOTAL EXPENSES (all categories): {sum(amounts):,.2f}')

# Cross-check with the file's own formula range C11:C22
assert len(amounts) == 12, 'formula range C11:C22 covers 12 rows'
print('Cross-check: file formula is =SUM(C11:C22) -> consistent with 12 items above')

income = sum(float(data[r]['B']) for r in range(4, 8))
print(f'Total Income (B8, =SUM(B4:B7)): {income:,.2f}')
print(f'Balance (B25, =B8-C22): {income - sum(amounts):,.2f}')
